Connection tips: Put both devices on the same Wi‑Fi or phone hotspot first. Use Share offer / Share answer and choose Bluetooth, Quick Share/Nearby Share, messaging, or another available method to transfer the setup text; the live circuit data then travels over the WebRTC network connection, not over Bluetooth itself. Direct Bluetooth-only networking is not supported consistently by standalone browser HTML. A STUN connection may need internet access, and some networks may block direct peer connections.

📷 Solve a problem from a picture

Take a new photo on Android or choose an existing image. The same photo is available in Offline and Online modes.

Problem photo

Offline mode reads printed problem text on this device. The first use may download an OCR engine, but the photo itself stays local. Online mode sends the photo only when you press Ask Online.

No photo selected. You can also type a problem directly in either mode.
Offline Guide · works without internetPhotos stay on this device in Offline mode. The app first tries built-in local text detection, then a browser-based OCR engine for printed text; on first use, that engine may need to download, but your image is processed locally and is not uploaded. The offline solver can solve Boolean expressions (up to 8 variables; up to 256 truth-table rows), truth tables, De Morgan transformations, canonical/simplified SOP and POS, and minterm/maxterm/K-map problems, plus arithmetic and single-variable linear equations; other questions use the built-in circuit guide. No text or image is sent to a server.

Online AI · connect your own APIConfigure an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint and a vision-capable model. Online photo solutions include the method, intermediate reasoning, and a clear final answer.
Privacy and compatibility: The page does not save the API key or photo to localStorage. When you click Ask Online, your prompt, any photo, and your entered key are sent to the endpoint you entered. Use a trusted endpoint and a vision-capable model for images. It must support browser CORS and OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions requests with image input. Browser calls may fail if the provider blocks CORS.
Online photo solving provides a detailed explanation and final answer. The response is plain text and never automatically rewires the circuit. The selected API/model must support vision for photos.

OR gateProblem 1

Find the output Y.

Y = A OR B

What is the output Y? Choose 0 (LOW) or 1 (HIGH).

Choose 0 or 1, then press Submit work.

How to solve it

Use these rules when working through the problem.

  • NOT: flips the input (0→1, 1→0).
  • AND: output is 1 only when every input is 1.
  • OR: output is 1 when at least one input is 1.
  • NAND: NOT of AND; output is 0 only when every input is 1.
  • NOR: NOT of OR; output is 1 only when every input is 0.

This practice set runs locally in the browser. It does not change or wire the circuit canvas.
